How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders placed before 12:00 PM EST generally ship out the same business day, and tracking information is generated once the label is created. Orders placed on a weekend or holiday are processed on the following business day.
On rare occasions, an item may be on backorder or out of stock, which can take up to 7 business days to process and ship.

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Delivery times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout and your location.
For standard domestic shipping within the continental U.S., packages generally arrive within a few business days after leaving our facility. If you selected an expedited option like Second Day or Next Day Air, transit times will be faster.
